progression.narrative: The performance opens on Eb4 and dwells most on Gk in Zarbi. The line peaks at Gk4 (387.7 Hz) at 0:15.2. It closes on Gk3, not the tonic (Eb4 → Eb4 → Gk4 → Eb4 → Fs4 → Gk3).
